verdicts.evidence: At 6fadd78, getChain's `!chainId` guard returned 404 while the message routes returned 422. The author called the point "fair" (comment of 2026-08-28), reworded the PR body and opened a follow-up in WA-3543. Commit 0bdbad0cb then removed the datasource guard, so validation now happens only at the controller.

The three-line comment is at config-api.service.ts:75-77 in 6fadd78. The author wrote "Trimmed to two lines" in 4424a1bc. It later became TSDoc in 089c4dbe, and the guard itself was removed in 0bdbad0cb.

At 6fadd78, config-api.service.spec.ts:122 asserts `new DataSourceError('Chain not found', 404)`. The author said "The spec now asserts HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND instead of the literal" (pushed in 4424a1bc).

The author declined point 4, the `toThrow` part of the bot's review, on 2026-08-28. They showed that `message` is a parameter property and that `toThrow` also compares `code`: changing 404 to 999 makes the test fail. They left the assertion as it was.

The author agreed that "the body overclaimed" about the 41 other sites and reworded the PR body so the guard is not presented as a substitute for piping the remaining `@Param('chainId')` sites. The follow-up is tracked in WA-3543.
